title: QUIC: add support for more QUIC versions
description:
See: https://github.com/quicwg/base-drafts/wiki/QUIC-Versions

Followup of a discussion in !1975

notes.body: LGTM @Lekensteyn What do you think to use range_string ?
Looks reasonable for the lack of more info about specific version numbers.

added 9 commits

enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for afeb15d4d831025c1b1bf740023fbac9b5fef671 succeeds
